Four analysts — Kiran, Lata, Manoj and Nisha — sat the same test and scored 160 marks between them. Their scores were all different whole numbers, and:

- Kiran scored more than Lata, who scored more than Manoj, who scored more than Nisha.
- Kiran scored exactly 8 marks more than Lata.
- Manoj scored 41 marks.
- Nisha scored 19 marks.
